title: RxNorm API Current Data Version
citation: U.S. National Library of Medicine. RxNorm API current data version 03-Aug-2026; API version 3.1.354.
populations: Not population-specific; normalized RxNorm ingredient concept identities

sourceRelations.note: This dated API snapshot supplies later normalized ingredient identity checks while preserving the older Current Prescribable Content snapshot used by existing records.

accessPolicy.licenseLabel: U.S. government public-domain RxNorm normalized names and codes
accessPolicy.note: NLM identifies RxNorm normalized names and codes as U.S. government public-domain data. PsychSim records only the dated API version and exact RXNORM ingredient properties needed for identity normalization. It excludes proprietary source-vocabulary content, retains NLM attribution, avoids endorsement implications, and does not treat identity metadata as a clinical claim.
